_note: Long single-point runs through the SAME code path as the sweep. Metrics,
window signature and classification come from the same functions, so a
point from here can be plotted on a stability map without recalibration.
Leave 'points' out to run the case nominal. Listing several points is how
you follow up a sweep: the calibrated point, and any point the sweep

fields._note: Instantaneous surface pressure and deflection. per_second writes one file per simulated second, so a job that dies at second 14 leaves 13 usable files. ~10 MB per second at single precision on the 101x51 grid.
